day_shape: Trump confirms US strike on Qeshm Island anti-aircraft system, State Department offers $20m bounty for Iran nuclear-program intel, CENTCOM task force announced for Iran weapons interdiction, Rezaei delivers Khamenei message to Putin, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US military and sanctions pressure on Iran
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump confirmed a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island destroying an anti-aircraft system, and said the US military is setting up a task force to restrict Tehran's movement of advanced weapons across land borders and the Caspian. The State Department offered up to $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear programme; CENTCOM posted an article the same day.

threads.label: Rezaei-Putin meeting and Iran-Russia ties
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported that National Security Council secretary Rezaei met Putin for three hours as bearer of a message from Khamenei, discussing US and Israeli strikes on Iran and Iran's seven-point conditions. Iran's ambassador to Moscow said military cooperation and a Russia-to-Iran gas transfer mega-project were reviewed.

threads.label: Tehran framing of US midterms and war costs
threads.summary: IRIB and Iran International reported Tehran casting Republican midterm losses as fallout from Trump's Iran war, with IRIB claiming European protests over war-driven price rises and Rezaei saying Vance, Rubio and Hegseth are on the way out. Erdogan told Trump by phone that Iran-US tensions should be resolved diplomatically, per Jerusalem Post.

threads.label: Israel post-war assessments and aborted operation
threads.summary: Channel 12, via Iran International, reported Netanyahu and the Mossad chief planned a pre-election Iran operation on October 27 that was dropped after an Israeli operative's mistake tipped off Washington. A former CENTCOM deputy commander told KAN that failure to destroy Iran's ballistic missile and drone capabilities was "probably the most significant failure" of the war.

threads.label: Iran domestic strains and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported Chinese solar panel imports to Iran fell more than 80% in 2026, the execution of Baluch man Mohammad Aref Shahbakhsh over a Khash police-post attack, and exiled prince Reza Pahlavi accepting Germany's Freedom Prize on behalf of Iranians in Frankfurt. IRIB reported Ahvaz and Ideh schools moving remote under a meteorological red alert and a welfare ministry explanation on subsidy card limits.

events.title_en: Hameti: There is no shortage in supply of essential goods
events.summary_en: In the first seven and a half months of the year, approximately 30 billion dollars of foreign exchange was provided for imports. There is no shortage in supply of essential goods and provision of raw materials for production and medicines continues. Over 9,000 efforts at credit payments have been made, with 75 per cent of that allocated to businesses and a major portion also to working capital. The enemy sought economic collapse, cutting off foreign exchange revenues and halting production, but with people's resistance and various organisations' efforts, it failed to achieve its goals. By standing firm against attempts to increase the exchange rate, in the past 40 days positive results have been achieved and a declining trend in the exchange rate has begun.

events.title_en: Ahvaz University of Medical Sciences explanation regarding death of 38-year-old mother after caesarean
events.summary_en: The mother was admitted on the second of Aban for her fourth delivery and third caesarean section. On the morning of the third of Aban she underwent surgery. The operation lasted approximately one hour and ten minutes with no particular problems reported during surgery. The patient was transferred to the ward following the operation and placed under supervision. Around 4am the next day, while getting out of bed to use the bathroom, she suffered fainting and fell. Resuscitation attempts were unsuccessful and she died. The university official rejected claims of the mother being alone in the room and the door being locked, saying the patient was admitted to a three-bed room alongside two other patients and their companions.

events.title: Iran’s exiled prince accepts German Freedom Prize for Iranians as thousands rally
events.summary: Iran’s exiled prince Reza Pahlavi accepted Germany’s Freedom Prize for the Iranian people in Frankfurt on Saturday, its first award to a nation rather than a person, and said he would hold it until he could hand it to them in Tehran, as tens of thousands rallied in the city.

events.title: Iran hangs Baluch man over attack on police post in Sistan and Baluchestan
events.summary: Iran executed Mohammad Aref Shahbakhsh on Saturday over an armed attack on a police post in Khash, in the southeastern province of Sistan and Baluchestan, the judiciary said, the latest hanging as fighting between Baluch militants and security forces spreads across the province.

events.title: Netanyahu's pre-election Iran operation was dropped after US was tipped off - Channel 12
events.summary: Israel’s prime minister and his Mossad chief planned an operation against Iran on the eve of Israel's October 27 election, over the objections of other security chiefs, and dropped it after a mistake by an Israeli operative tipped off Washington, Channel 12 reported on Friday.
